breakouts.h: Next up: the breakout candidates for the new season
breakouts.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

list.name: R.Hardy
list.d: [[p:557719215|R.Hardy]] slides into the starting lineup with E.DaSilva gone. Also: he piled up 5 sacks without starting. He brings a edge setter skill set to a scheme that ranks 19th in defensive rush yards per game. This is the year.
